environment.description: Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private subnet. The NLB target group has a static IP preserved via Elastic IP association. Upstream traffic arrives through a separate edge proxy (Envoy 1.28) running on a bastion host in a DMZ subnet. The Envoy listener has a CIDR-based RBAC filter configured in the transport_socket context that restricts downstream connections to three known partner CIDR ranges (10.200.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/14, 192.168.50.0/24) using the envoy.filters.network.rbac filter with DENY action on non-matching source IPs evaluated BEFORE the HTTP connection manager. The NLB security group additionally restricts ingress to only the DMZ subnet CIDR (10.100.0.0/24) where the Envoy proxy resides. There is no public route to the NLB or the Fargate tasks. DNS resolution for the service endpoint is only available via a Route53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC. The Envoy proxy does NOT perform any payload inspection, header filtering, or request sanitization - it solely enforces source IP allowlisting at L3/L4.
